svg.title: How the model test of switching works
svg.desc: fast-check makes up an evening of up to 60 steps: actions of the extension and events in the page, at Autodarts and on the network, in any order. They run against a fake page whose requests can fail, a storage that keeps JSON and a fake Autodarts that rotates every refresh token. After every step the test checks its rules; when one breaks, fast-check shrinks the evening to the shortest one that breaks it and prints it with its seed.
